files.purpose: Create a portable current-state specification and precontract agreement document for website, academy and admin, with explicit paid maintenance and scope-change boundaries.
files.previous_behavior: No unified source-backed interactive scope, staged acceptance and agreement history document existed. Existing reports did not provide per-item release/cost decisions and portable revision history.
files.new_behavior: A standalone offline HTML inventories every one of 168 current page paths and 55 API paths, documents 192 page/backend features and 21 security items, provides 56 precontract decisions, separates initial delivery/defect correction/paid maintenance/additional work, records before-after changes and baseline-specific confirmations, supports portable HTML/JSON backups, validates compatible history on import, and prints the complete document.
files.data_impact: Reads embedded source-derived metadata and previously collected aggregate production observations. User edits write only browser localStorage and explicitly downloaded HTML/JSON files. QA uses separate project IDs. No production records, schema, accounts, permissions or deployed services are changed.
files.access_control_impact: none: the document does not change platform authorization or grant access. Party confirmations are manually recorded references, not authenticated signatures. Imports require matching project/commit, checksum, valid fields and a complete compatible event prefix; concurrent-tab storage changes block overwrites.
risks: Source-level implementation findings must not be confused with complete runtime acceptance or verified production coverage.
Local browser history and portable files require versioned shared storage and external approval evidence; file integrity checks do not authenticate the author or prevent deliberate rewriting.
A new audited catalog needs explicit reconciliation rather than silently reusing this commit-scoped project ID and enumerated feature IDs.
Embedded fonts increase the single HTML size to approximately 3.2 MB.
files.rollback: Remove docs/bayada-contract-review.html or revert this commit. Export any user-created browser history as HTML/JSON before removing the tool. Production apps and databases need no rollback; local browser storage remains until the user removes it.

production_safety.operational_data: No production data was created, updated or deleted in this implementation. The artifact reuses aggregate read-only server observations collected earlier on 2026-11-17 and reconciles those against existing migration documentation. QA writes only separate local browser test projects.
production_safety.schema_migration: none: no schema, migration, operational backfill or deployment change.
external_side_effects: Read-only official legal/security source browsing and Oinzi local-file visual/functional review.
Local QA exercised separate test histories, downloads intercepted during automated checks, and temporary test documents.
No external messages, production deployments, permission changes or real party approvals.
